name: Local Grove Pre-Roll | Gushers | 1G
description: Bred by Connected California, Gushers is a cross between Triangle Kush and Gelato #41. It is no surprise that it shares a name with the gummy fruit snack of our childhood as it bursts with a sweet and gassy scent that will have you reaching for that bag of candy. With undertones of gas, herbs, and cookies, the flavor largely matches the smell.
